result.summary: The page is generally well-structured and visually consistent. A few minor issues were found: horizontal content clipping in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, and a possible state mismatch in the bottom navigation where 'Profile' appears active while Home content is displayed.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' row ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge with its title truncated and no visible scroll affordance or fade indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge gradient fade or partial-card peek with a clear scroll hint so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable; ensure title truncation uses an ellipsis consistently.

issues.description: The bottom navigation shows 'Profile' highlighted in green (active state) while the screen content is the Home feed, which can confuse users about their current location.
issues.suggestion: Sync the active tab state with the displayed screen; highlight 'Home' when the home feed is shown, or navigate to the Profile screen if Profile is intended to be active.

issues.description: The notification bell icon relies on a small red dot to convey unread status, which may be missed by users with low vision or color-vision deficiencies and lacks a textual/badge count.
issues.suggestion: Add a numeric badge or an accessible label (e.g., aria-label='Notifications, 1 unread') and ensure the indicator meets size and contrast guidelines.
